home.title: MENA Cyber Wire: Real-time Cyber Security Intelligence for Middle East & North Africa
home.description: Live cybersecurity telemetry, primary source reporting on regional ransomware campaigns, state-sponsored APT attacks, critical infrastructure threats, and regulatory directives across Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, and North Africa.

breaking.title: Breaking Cybersecurity News & Active Incident Wire | MENA Cyber Wire
breaking.description: Real-time updates on active cyber attacks, zero-day alerts, and emergency advisories impacting GCC and MENA organizations.

threats.title: Vulnerability Intelligence & CISA KEV Exploits in MENA | MENA Cyber Wire
threats.description: Continuous vulnerability tracking, NVD CVSS telemetry, actively exploited vulnerabilities in perimeter equipment (PAN-OS, Ivanti, FortiOS), and remediation guidance.

dailyBrief.title: Daily Cyber Intelligence Brief & Defensive Telemetry | MENA Cyber Wire
dailyBrief.description: Executive threat summary, daily regional risk level, sector-targeted advisories, and immediate defensive actions for CISOs and security analysts.

research.title: APT Threat Actor Profiles & Deep Cyber Espionage Research | MENA Cyber Wire
research.description: Detailed threat dossiers on state-sponsored APT groups (MuddyWater, Charming Kitten, OilRig, Sandworm) active in the Middle East, with TTPs, MITRE ATT&CK mappings, and IOCs.

mena.title: Regional Cybersecurity Desks & Sovereign Regulatory Watch | MENA Cyber Wire
mena.description: Country-by-country intelligence across 13 Middle East & North African nations, tracking sovereign CERTs, PDPL laws, and threat postures.

community.title: Security Community & Practitioner Threat Exchange | MENA Cyber Wire
community.description: Vetted peer forum for MENA cybersecurity engineers, incident responders, and compliance officers sharing verified insights and threat mitigation.
